improvement_suggestions: Reduce redundant navigation and rearrange retries after success feedback to minimize unnecessary steps and negative reward accumulation.
Tighten the replan windows so that once an action is confirmed successful, the planner immediately advances to the next subgoal instead of issuing duplicate Rearrange commands.
Incorporate a cost-aware planning heuristic that penalizes repeated actions on already-satisfied propositions to improve total reward efficiency.
overall_assessment: All task propositions were ultimately completed successfully, but the trajectory was inefficient with repeated rearrange actions and excessive replanning that led to a relatively poor total reward.
